$comment: TEMPLATE (TASK-160) — copy to .github/sync-config.json. Every exclude starts with '/' (audit H-3; TASK-204, R-80): rsync anchors such a pattern at the transfer root, so '/package.json' is the root file and '/types/**' the root types/ directory only. A pattern without a leading '/' is matched against the END of every path — a bare name at any depth, and 'types/**' inside 'shared/types/' too — silently keeping platform files of the same name out of your app; workflow-hygiene refuses one. The consumer seams are always excluded (docs/SETUP_AND_INTEGRATION.md §6).
